This powerful formula helps fade discoloration, even out skin tone, and improve skin clarity for a more radiant and even complexion.

Formulated with Glutathione for enhanced synergy, it accelerates spots fading. This fast-absorbing cream provides soothing hydration for sensitive skin, leaving a non-sticky, refreshing finish without irritation. Perfect for all skin types.
